human.problem: Three story cards in stop 2 call back to an earlier verse but cite only the current verse. Card 1 recalls David's oath (v2) and cites only Psalm 132:11. Card 7 recalls 'arise to His resting place' (v8) and cites only Psalm 132:14. Card 11 recalls the priests clothed with righteousness (v9) and cites only Psalm 132:16. Two rules pull in different directions here. One says a story card cites 'from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.' The other says 'Every Bible fact he states carries its reference.' Citing each range in full (2-11, 8-14, 9-16) would sweep in many verses the card doesn't tell.
human.question: When a story card calls back to an earlier verse in the same passage, how should the card cite it? Options: cite only the verse being told, list the separate verses (like Psalm 132:9, 16), or cite the full range from the earlier verse to the current one.
